g.text: 75 V max | 50-100 kHz | Not for manufacture

g.desc: 75 V max | 50-100 kHz | Not for manufacture

g.text: 6. Verify VDS overshoot, capacitance bias/ripple, current sharing, coolant conditions and completed routing before release.

g.text: 1. One cell is one-sixth of the future 220 A RMS module: about 51.9 A peak with ideal sinusoidal sharing.

g.desc: 1. One cell is one-sixth of the future 220 A RMS module: about 51.9 A peak with ideal sinusoidal sharing.

g.text: 75 V max bus | 50 kHz nominal, 100 kHz max | One of six eventual parallel cells

g.desc: 75 V max bus | 50 kHz nominal, 100 kHz max | One of six eventual parallel cells

g.text: PLACEMENT PROTOTYPE - NOT FOR MANUFACTURE OR FULL-CURRENT TEST

g.desc: PLACEMENT PROTOTYPE - NOT FOR MANUFACTURE OR FULL-CURRENT TEST

g.text: 2. QH1 / QL1 symbol exposes every package pad: 1 gate; 2,4,6 source; 3,5,7 drain. No separate Kelvin package pin.

g.desc: 2. QH1 / QL1 symbol exposes every package pad: 1 gate; 2,4,6 source; 3,5,7 drain. No separate Kelvin package pin.

g.text: 3. Gate return must take off at the source pad nearest the gate; copper geometry defines Kelvin performance.

g.desc: 3. Gate return must take off at the source pad nearest the gate; copper geometry defines Kelvin performance.

g.text: 4. Cold plate contacts the source-connected FET tops through insulating TIM. Driver circuitry is external.

g.desc: 4. Cold plate contacts the source-connected FET tops through insulating TIM. Driver circuitry is external.

g.text: 5. Port pads and driver pads are interface placeholders, not selected/rated connectors. RG values require driver tuning.

g.desc: 5. Port pads and driver pads are interface placeholders, not selected/rated connectors. RG values require driver tuning.

g.text: C1-C4: placement candidates, 8.8 uF nominal total.

g.desc: C1-C4: placement candidates, 8.8 uF nominal total.

g.text: Retained C at 75 V and RMS heating NOT yet verified.

g.text: External bulk DC-link connection is required.
